metadata.title: Quad-Panel Band Portrait with Overlaid Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel composition featuring four distinct vertical portrait strips unified by a large, thin-weight sans-serif title spanning the lower third.
excludeWhen: a single unified background is required
heavy serif or decorative typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A quadtych arrangement of four vertical portrait panels, each containing a close-up headshot of a different individual, overlaid with a large-scale, thin-stroke geometric sans-serif title that spans across all four panels.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical panel divisions acting as frames for individual subjects
Horizontal typographic alignment bridging the vertical seams
Consistent lighting and focal length across all four portraits
Contrast between the detailed photographic textures and the flat, clean graphic overlay
coreInvariants: Large-scale display text positioned in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects, each centered within their respective vertical panel, scaled to fill the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large horizontal text spanning the width of the composition acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move horizontally across the faces, then drop to the text, following the baseline across the panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space within panels; the text creates its own negative space through thin strokes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural skin tones and varied clothing colors (red, blue, black) within panels.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the primary display typography to ensure legibility against dark clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold or yellow for secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key lighting on faces with deep shadows in the clothing and backgrounds to provide a base for white text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal width for the 'L' and 'E' to bridge panel gaps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a light-weight, wide display font and a heavy-weight, condensed subtitle font.

preserve: Thin stroke weight of main title

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric precision and thin stroke weight match the display style.
Modern, clean aesthetic with appropriate proportions for wide tracking.
Suitable for the heavy, compact subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a quadtych of four vertical panels, each featuring a close-up portrait of a different man with early 2000s hairstyles, wearing different colored shirts (red, blue, black, black), against a neutral studio background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, thin-weight white sans-serif title in all-caps across the lower third of the image. Below the second panel's portion of the title, add a three-line subtitle in a bold, condensed yellow sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly four vertical panels?
Is the main title thin-weight and white?
Does the text span across the panel boundaries?
Is the subtitle bold and yellow?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific band logos
Do not replicate the exact faces of the original artists
Ensure the typography is a generic geometric sans-serif

mustAchieve: Consistent lighting across all four portraits
avoid: Illegible thin text against light backgrounds

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly horizontal and not warped.
Verify that each panel contains only one face.
Ensure the vertical seams are sharp and distinct.
Confirm the color contrast between the white text and the dark clothing.
recipe.reuseFormula: Quad-panel vertical split + Thin geometric sans-serif overlay + Bold condensed subtitle offset.
